name: Official SalesWizard CRM
author: SalesWizard.pl

sections.description:
The Official SalesWizard CRM Plugin integrates seamlessly with Contact Form 7 and WPForms to send form data directly to the SalesWizard CRM system. This plugin allows you to capture and manage your form submissions efficiently and securely in your CRM.

License

GPL Version 3

Languages

  • English (en_US)
  • Polish (pl_PL)
sections.installation:
1. Install the Official SalesWizard CRM Plugin either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server. (See instructions on how to install a WordPress plugin)
  2. Activate the Official SalesWizard CRM Plugin.
  3. Navigate to the SalesWizard CRM tab in your admin menu, click the “Settings” tab, and complete all fields as required.
sections.faq:
Who should use the Official SalesWizard CRM Plugin?

  • Anyone who needs to save WPForms and Contact Form 7 data into a database. This plugin allows you to send form data to SalesWizard CRM directly from your WordPress site.

Do I need to have coding skills to use the Official SalesWizard CRM Plugin?

  • Absolutely not. The plugin is designed to be easy to use without any coding knowledge.
